Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.01), which favours a robust combination.

Series context: trend strength 0.6255 and seasonal strength 0.2119; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.01); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.204.
